llm_response.reason: The site displays none of the classic scam signals: there are no promises of unrealistic returns, no urgency tactics beyond regular retail sales, no ambiguous contact details or payment methods, and no ambiguous company information. Privacy and business information is clearly presented, including links to privacy and cookie statements as well as a reputable Dutch e-commerce trustmark (Webshop-keurmerk). The domain is well-established since 2010, with valid WHOIS details. All product and service offerings are typical for an online retailer in this niche.
